[[PW0:001]]
30% of users care most about stability and cost-effectiveness when using AI services, and DeepSeek V4 Flash and its Vision Exp version have been optimized in this regard. These two models perform excellently in code development, AI agents, and visual analysis, especially with impressive responsiveness in high-frequency API workflows.

[[PW0:002]]
Specifically, DeepSeek V4 Flash has extremely fast response times and low-latency characteristics, maintaining stable service under high-concurrency scenarios. Its Vision Exp version excels in multimodal analysis, capable of handling complex visual tasks and datasets. The price adjustment of these two models means developers can access cost-effective services at a lower price.

[[PW0:003]]
https://t.co/hkGQdLxMBf announced that it will launch exclusive stacking benefits at 12:00 (SGT) on September 10, further reducing the cost for developers to use these two popular models. This strategy not only helps developers lower the barrier to entry but also enhances their trust in https://t.co/hkGQdLxMBf, encouraging more people to try and use these powerful tools.

[[PW0:004]]
The price adjustment of DeepSeek V4 Flash and Vision Exp is a major boon for the developer community. https://t.co/hkGQdLxMBf will bring more usage value to users through a series of exclusive benefits. Now, simply following official updates will allow you to get more discount information at the earliest opportunity.

[[PW0:005]]
@justinsuntron @BAI_AGI #TRONEcostar
[[PW0:END]]
